    SELECT 
        r.constructorId, 
        c.name, 
        c.nationality,
        COALESCE(CAST(r.points AS REAL)) AS total_points
    FROM results r
    JOIN constructors c ON r.constructorId = c.constructorId
    WHERE r.raceId = 'Monaco Grand Prix' 
      AND r.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010
    GROUP BY r.constructorId, c.name, c.nationality
),
max_score AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM constructor_totals
    WHERE total_points = (
        SELECT MAX(total_points)

    )
),
final_results AS (
    SELECT 
        cs.name AS constructor_name,

        SELECT

        WHERE raceId IN ('Monaco Grand Prix')

    ) cs ON final_results.constructorId = cs.constructorId
)
